name: robinhood
notes: Robinhood Chain mainnet (Arbitrum Orbit, gas in ETH). The public RPC is rate-limited; point ROBINHOOD_RPC at a QuickNode/Dwellir/ArrowRPC endpoint for the keeper and watcher. $RIG is launched on Pons and graduates to a Uniswap v3 RIG/WETH pool (1% tier) whose position is locked by the Pons locker; there is no fungible LP token, so LP staking is off (lpToken zero). Fill rig with the graduated token address, deploy OpenEligibility and ChainlinkOracle (feeds above), set treasury. Testnet: chain id 46630 at https://rpc.testnet.chain.robinhood.com (verified).
feedsNote: Chainlink proxies on chain 4663 (reference-data-directory feeds-robinhood-mainnet.json, 2026-09-04): 8 decimals, 24 h heartbeat, 0.5% deviation. NVDA verified live at $230.24. Also available: SPY 0x319724394D3A0e3669269846abE664Cd621f9f6A, ETH/USD 0x78F3556b67E17Df817D51Ef5a990cDaF09E8d3A9, USDG/USD 0x61B7e5650328764B076A108EFF5fa7282a1B9aD2. Deploy ChainlinkOracle(stocks, feeds) and put its address in `oracle`; deploy OpenEligibility for `eligibility`.
deployedNote: Mainnet 2026-09-05 from deployer 0x0F89e3Ce3e4646341De2f71C0Da2C7cea5CeD0a2: factory, OpenEligibility, ChainlinkOracle (feeds verified live). rig stays zero until the Pons launch.
rigNote: $RIG "Stock Miner" (RIG, 18 decimals, 1e27 supply) verified on chain 2026-09-05
feeWalletNote: Pons tax recipient (client, 2026-09-08). Receives the trading tax in ETH; its key is FUNDER_KEY on the funding service only. Swaps into the four Stock Tokens and calls RoundMine.fund via fund-rounds --loop.
poolsNote: Uniswap v3 pools of each Stock Token against WETH on chain 4663, discovered 2026-09-08 via factory.getPool: the deepest WETH pool per stock (NVDA 0.05%: 1.7e22 liquidity; MU 0.3%: 5.2e20; SNDK 0.3%: 3.0e20; QQQ 0.3%: 2.8e21). FeeFunder swaps against these; the owner can re-point with setLegs.
